name: Intl locale formats
plain: Number, date, calendar, numbering system and hour cycle formats the browser would use.
meaning: resolvedOptions() exposes calendar (gregory, buddhist, japanese), numberingSystem (latn, arab), hourCycle (h12 or h23), and decimal and thousands marks. Reveals regional OS settings beyond language.

access.persistence: read fresh on every page load; nothing stored
access.iframe: Readable from cross-origin iframes too (same values)

limits.headline: Can see the date, number and clock formats your browser uses
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when the page or app loads
can: Check the calendar type, number style and 12 or 24 hour clock
Show dates and numbers the way you expect
Learn about your regional settings beyond your language
cannot: See your exact location from it
See your files or settings outside the browser
Show a permission pop up; there is none

story.what_it_is: The page sees how your device writes dates, numbers and clocks.

marketing.name: Intl
marketing.pitch: Describes built in tools that format dates, numbers and currency for the person's region and language.

story.for_you: A price, date or time appears the way you are used to, like 15/11/2026 or 3:00 PM. You do not see that the page asked your device how it writes them. No prompt appears.
story.for_makers: Makers need local formats to show prices and dates correctly. The same details, such as calendar and number system, are extra clues to country and language, which fingerprinting scripts like.

use_cases.example: A store shows prices with the right currency symbol and decimals for your country.
A booking site shows dates and 12 or 24 hour times as you expect.
A browser game shows event timers and in game dates in your local style.
A bank shows balances with the right thousands separator and calendar.
A fingerprinting script reads calendar and numbering system as a clue to region.
A fraud engine compares formats with the claimed country and flags a mismatch.

technical_bounds: Follows browser locale, not guaranteed OS
